text.p: Italy's BTP futures held slightly easier in late afternoon trading reflecting the easier tone to many other world bond markets and some weakness in the lira.
"There is very little happening out there, and the BTP market is watching the weakness in the U.S. and the trend in bunds," said one dealer on the LIFFE market.

Dealers added that although the underlying sentiment on the Italian market remained fundamentally bullish based on continued optimism over Italy being a founder member of the single European currency, the market had to take into account the lower trend in other global bond markets.
